IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION_.en: Take a quick tour of your PRODUCT_NAME: where your apps are, how to get more, and the Linux underneath. 7 steps.

IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_DIALOG_TITLE_TEXT.en: Hi there. Welcome to your PRODUCT_NAME.

IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_FILES_APP_BUBBLE_AC.en: Tour step STEP of TOTAL_STEPS. You can find the Files app in Launcher. Home is your Linux home folder: Linux apps and the Files app see the same files, and cloud storage you add in Settings shows up here too.
IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_FILES_APP_BUBBLE_AC.t: Uhambo lwesinyathelo esingu-STEP kwezingu-TOTAL_STEPS. Ungathola i-app yamafayela esiqalisini. Ikhaya liyifolda yakho yasekhaya ye-Linux: izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Linux ne-app yamafayela zibona amafayela afanayo, futhi isitoreji samafu osengeza Kuzilungiselelo naso sivela lapha.

IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_FILES_APP_BUBBLE_BO.en: Home is your Linux home folder: Linux apps and the Files app see the same files, and cloud storage you add in Settings shows up here too.

IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_NICKEL_ANDROID_BUBB.en: Tour step STEP of TOTAL_STEPS. Waydroid runs Android apps, each in a window of its own. Set it up in Settings, under Apps, then Android apps. After that, opening an APK file installs the app, and Android’s apps show up in Launcher.
IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_NICKEL_ANDROID_BUBB.t: Uhambo lwesinyathelo esingu-STEP kwezingu-TOTAL_STEPS. I-Waydroid isebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Android, ngayinye ewindini layo. Yisethe Kuzilungiselelo, ngaphansi kokuthi Izinhlelo zokusebenza, bese kuba okuthi Izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Android. Ngemva kwalokho, ukuvula ifayela le-APK kufaka i-app, futhi ama-app e-Android avela Esiqalisini.

IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_NICKEL_ANDROID_BUBB.en: Waydroid runs Android apps, each in a window of its own. Set it up in Settings > Apps > Android apps. After that, opening an APK file installs the app, and Android’s apps show up in Launcher.

IDS_ASH_WELCOME_TOUR_NICKEL_TERMINAL_BUB.en: Tour step STEP of TOTAL_STEPS. The Terminal is a real Linux shell, with sudo. NickelOS is Gentoo underneath: eix finds packages and sudo emerge installs them, as on any Gentoo.

IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3Izakhi zokulungisa amaphuthaEND_H3
          BR
          Ungasebenzisa izakhi zokulungisa amaphutha kudivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS ukuze ufake uphinde uhlole ikhodi yomuntu ngamunye kudivayisi yakho.  Lokhu kuzokuvumela ukuthi:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMUsuse ukuqinisekiswa kwe-rootfs ukuze ulungise amafayela e-OS
            LIST_ITEMUsebenzise ukufinyelela kwe-SSH kudivayisi usebenzisa okhiye abajwayelekile bokuhlola ukuze ukwazi ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afana ne-BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE ukuze ufinyelele kudivayisi
            LIST_ITEMUkusebenzisa ukuqalisa kusukela ku-USB ukuze ufake isithombe se-OS kusuka kudrayivu ye-USB
            LIST_ITEMSetha kokubili iphasiwedi yokungena ye-dev kanye neye-system root kunani elenziwe ngokomuntu ngamunye ukuze ukwazi ukufaka nge-SSH kudivayisi ngesandla
          END_LIST
          BR
          Uma sekuvuliwe, iningi lezakhi zokulungisa amaphutha zizohlala zisebenza nangemuva kokwenza i-powerwash noma ukusula idatha kudivayisi elawulwayo yebhizinisi.  Ukuze uvale ngokugcwele zonke izakhi zokususa amaphutha, phinda ufake i-NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nezakhi zokulungisa amaphutha bheka okuthi:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDQaphela:END_BOLD  Isistimu izoqalisa kabusha phakathi nenqubo.

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.t: I-APP_NAME ifuna ukulawula ikhibhodi nesikhombi sale divayisi. Kuvumele kuphela uma umethemba noma ubani oxhumayo.

IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.en: You chose Minimal when you set up NickelOS, so no search engine was picked for you. These search engines are popular in your region and are shown in random order.
IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.t: Ukhethe okuthi Okuncane lapho usetha i-NickelOS, ngakho akukho njini yokusesha eyakhethelwa wena. Lezi zinjini zokusesha zidumile esifundeni sakho futhi ziboniswa ngokulandelana okungahleliwe.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.en: Either way, you get Bazaar to find more apps, and apps to open your photos, videos, music and documents.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.t: Noma ngabe yikuphi, uthola i-Bazaar ukuze uthole ama-app engeziwe, nama-app okuvula izithombe zakho, amavidiyo, umculo namadokhumenti.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Konke kulungile, futhi kuyimfihlo. I-DuckDuckGo isesha iwebhu kusukela esipheqululini naseSiqalisini, i-uBlock Origin ivimba izikhangiso nabalandeleli esipheqululini, ama-app ayimfihlo e-Proton (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass nokunye) ayafakwa, futhi ama-app wamahhala, womthombo ovulekile afika nayo: i-LibreOffice, i-OBS Studio, i-GIMP, i-Kdenlive nokunye.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Okuyisisekelo kuphela. Isiqalisi sisesha kule khompyutha kuphela, futhi akukho okunye okusethelwa wena.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Ngaphambi kokuqalisa, qiniseka ukuthi unesipele sedatha yakho. Ukufaka i-DEVICE_OS kuzobhala ngaphezulu idiski oyikhethayo.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: I-DEVICE_OS iyisofthiwe yamahhala enikezwa njengoba injalo: kungenzeka ingasebenzi kuyo yonke ikhompyutha, futhi ababhali bayo abanasibopho sokulahleka kwedatha.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SANITIZE_FEEDBACK.en: Help make NickelOS better by reporting the BEGIN_LINKcurrent settingsEND_LINK
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SANITIZE_FEEDBACK.t: Siza i-NickelOS ibe ngcono ngokubika BEGIN_LINKamasethingi amanjeEND_LINK

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Uma isikrini sakho singasebenzi, bonisa izithombe zakho, isikhathi, nolwazi lwemidiya

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Isigcini sesikrini sibonisa izithombe ezisefolda yakho ethi Izithombe nasemafoldeni angaphakathi kwayo. Engeza okungenani ezi-2.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Isigcini sesikrini sibonisa izithombe zangemuva ze-NickelOS. Vula lokhu ukuze kuboniswe izithombe ezitholakala ku-Amafayela ami > Pictures esikhundleni sazo.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Kusuka ku-Open-Meteo, kwendawo yakho ecishe ibe yiyo, enqunywa yi-beaconDB ngekheli lakho le-IP

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Qinisekisa ukuthi iphrinta yakho ivuliwe futhi ixhumeke kunethiwekhi efanayo nedivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS noma sebenzisa ikhebuli ye-USB

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Uma ivuliwe, idatha ilondolozwa kwiGoogle Account yakho futhi ingasetshenziswa kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho. Uma ivaliwe, idatha ilondolozwa kuphela kule divayisi. Ngokuphathelene nokungakhethwa kukho kokuvumelanisa kwe-NickelOS, iya LINK_BEGINkumasethingi e-NickelOSLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Nikeza ama-app e-Android ukulawula kumadivayisi e-USB kule divayisi ye-NickelOS. Imvume izocelwa njalo lapho uxhuma idivayisi ye-USB. Ama-app we-Android ngamanye azocela izimvume ezengeziwe.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Idivayisi yakho ayisatholi izibuyekezo zokuvikeleka nesofthiwe.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Idivayisi yakho ayisatholi izibuyekezo zokuvikeleka nesofthiwe.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Nikeza ama-app e-Android ukulawula kumadivayisi e-USB kule divayisi ye-NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Le nketho isebenza kumadivayisi e-NickelOS anohlelo lwedatha noma i-dongle yenethiwekhi yeselula, noma lapho usebenzisa ifoni njengemodemu ku-hotspot ephathekayo

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Uzophuma ngemvume. Esikrinini sokungena ngemvume, umuntu omusha ukhetha igama, igama lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Abalawuli bangafakela wonke umuntu isofthiwe, bashintshe isistimu futhi baphathe ama-akhawunti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Le divayisi idinga okungenani umlawuli oyedwa

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Akekho omunye umuntu one-akhawunti kule divayisi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Wonke umuntu une-akhawunti yakhe namafayela akhe. Abalawuli bangafakela wonke umuntu isofthiwe, bashintshe isistimu futhi baphathe ama-akhawunti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: I-akhawunti yakhe nawo wonke amafayela akhe kuyasuswa kule divayisi. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Umlawuli wale divayisi kuphela ongashintsha lokhu.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Okwama-app akhelwe kuphela amaphrosesa e-ARM asetshenziswa amafoni, kuhlanganise nemidlalo eminingi. Isofthiwe yobunikazi, elandwa lapho ukuvula.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi ze-Android, ikakhulukazi imidlalo, zakhelwe kuphela amaphrosesa e-ARM asetshenziswa amafoni. Ukuze zisebenze kule khompyutha, i-Android idinga umhumushi. I-NickelOS ayiwenzi futhi ayinawo: ukuvula lokhu kulanda i-TRANSLATOR ku-GitHub, ikhophi efanayo efakwa yi-waydroid_script yomphakathi we-Waydroid.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Iyisofthiwe yobunikazi, engaphansi kwemigomo yomnikazi wayo, futhi nguwe oyifakayo. Amanye ama-app angasebenza kancane noma angasebenzi nhlobo. I-Android iqala kabusha ukuze iyisebenzise.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Ukulanda akuqedanga. Hlola uxhumano lwakho, bese uzama futhi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Isusa i-Android, izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ze-Android nedatha yazo

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: I-Android, izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ze-Android nedatha yazo kuyasuswa kule divayisi. Abanye abantu abayisebenzisayo bagcina idatha yabo ye-Android, kodwa abakwazi ukuvula izinhlelo zabo zokusebenza ze-Android kuze kube yilapho i-Android isethwa futhi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Android zivuleka emawindini azo, eduze kwamanye ama-app akho. Ukusetha kulanda i-Android (i-LineageOS, evela kuphrojekthi ye-Waydroid): cishe u-1 GB, futhi ithatha u-2.5 GB kule divayisi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Bona i-Google Drive, i-OneDrive, i-Dropbox nesinye isitoreji samafu ku-Amafayela

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: I-Google Drive idinga i-ID yakho yeklayenti nemfihlo yakho evela kukhonsoli ye-Google Cloud.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Ayikwazanga ukuxhuma. Hlola imininingwane bese uzama futhi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: I-NickelOS isebenzisa i-rclone ukubonisa isitoreji sakho samafu ku-Amafayela, ukuze amafayela akho afinyeleleke kalula. Khetha isevisi ozongena kuyo ngemvume.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: I-app yamafayela iyayeka ukubonisa le akhawunti. Amafayela akho ahlala emafini, futhi ungayengeza futhi i-akhawunti kamuva.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Qedela ukungena ngemvume ekhasini elivuleke esipheqululini sakho.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Uma uxhuma, ikhasi lokungena ngemvume lesevisi livuleka esipheqululini sakho.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Umlawuli wale khompyutha kuphela ongashintsha igama layo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Amanye amadivayisi abona leli gama kunethiwekhi yakho nange-Bluetooth, futhi Itheminali nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Linux ziyalibonisa.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Sebenzisa okungenani uhlamvu olulodwa kusuka ku-A kuya ku-Z noma inombolo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Ama-app avula uhlobo ngalunye lwefayela, usuka ku-Amafayela nasezinhlelweni zokusebenza ze-Linux

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Amadrayivu angaphakathi kule divayisi ngaphandle kwaleyo ene-NickelOS. Idrayivu ene-Windows ivuleka ngokufunda kuphela, ukuze i-Windows ihlale ingonakele.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: I-Windows ikule drayivu. Ingeyokufunda kuphela ngaphandle kokuthi uvumele izinguquko.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: Nge-Fast Startup, i-Windows ayicishi ngokuphelele, futhi izinguquko ezenziwe lapha zingalahleka noma zonakalise amafayela lapho i-Windows iqala futhi. Vala i-Fast Startup ku-Windows, noma ubambe u-Shift ngenkathi ucisha i-Windows, ngaphambi kokwenza izinguquko.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: I-Windows ayizange icishe ngokuphelele, ngakho idrayivu ihlala ingeyokufunda kuphela. Cisha i-Windows ngokuphelele ukuze wenze izinguquko.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: I-Portage ne-emerge kusukela ekuqaleni, nemiyalo efanayo ye-pacman ne-apt eceleni

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Indlela i-NickelOS esebenza ngayo. Le khophi ize nenguqulo yakho ye-NickelOS futhi iyasebenza ngisho ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Amalogi, imibiko yokuphahlazeka, nezinkinga ezivamile nendlela yokuzixazulula

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Nge-app ye-KDE Connect ku-Android noma ku-iPhone, kunethiwekhi ye-Wi‑Fi efanayo

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Awekho amafoni noma amathebulethi okwamanje. Faka i-KDE Connect usuka ku-Google Play, ku-F‑Droid noma ku-App Store, uyivule kunethiwekhi ye-Wi‑Fi efanayo, bese ubhangqa usuka kunoma iyiphi kulawa madivayisi womabili.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Ukuxhumana kwamafoni akusebenzi. Phuma ngemvume bese uphinda ungena ngemvume ukuze ukuqalise.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Ivumela ama-app afana ne-Discord ukusebenzisa ukucindezela-ukuze-ukhulume ngenkathi usemawindini amanye. Abona okhiye abacindezelwe ne-Ctrl, i-Alt noma ukhiye Wosesho, kanye nokhiye bomsebenzi, kodwa angakuboni lokho okuthayiphayo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.t: Okhiye bezinqamuleli bezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Linux ezindala

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Qinisekisa ukuthi iphrinta yakho ixhunywe kunethiwekhi ye-Wi-Fi efanayo nedivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS noma sebenzisa ikhebuli ye-USB. LINK_BEGINFunda kabanzi mayelana nokuhambelanaLINK_END

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Ayikwazi ukuxhumeka kuphrinta. Hlola ukuthi iphrinta ivuliwe futhi ixhunywe kudivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS nge-Wi-Fi noma i-USB.

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Ukuze uqalise, sicela uqiniseke ukuthi i-USB yakho noma iswishi ye-Bluetooth ixhunyiwe kudivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS. Ungasebenzisa nokhiye bekhibhodi yakho.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Ukuze uvule idivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS, qinisekisa ukuthi i-Bluetooth yefoni yakho ivuliwe

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: I-Bluetooth yedivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS ivaliwe. Ukuze uvule idivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS, faka iphasiwedi.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Ifoni yakho ayinaso isikrini sokukhiya. Ukuze uvule idivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS, faka iphasiwedi.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Ukuze uvule idivayisi yakho ye-NickelOS, qala uvule ifoni yakho

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Idivayisi yakho isebenzisa inzwa eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ukuthola abantu abangaphambi kwayo. Yonke idatha icutshungulwa kudivayisi yakho ngokushesha bese iyasuswa. Idatha yenzwa ayilokothi ithunyelwe ku-Google.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: Uzongena ngemvume kudivayisi yakho nge-akhawunti yakho, futhi wonke umuntu oyisebenzisayo angaba neyakhe.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: I-NickelOS idizayinelwe ngokucabangela ukuvikeleka, futhi izibuyekeza ngokuzenzakalelayo.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: I-NickelOS isebenzisa ama-app ewebhu nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Linux ndawonye. Thola izinhlelo zokusebenza zokukhiqiza, okokuzijabulisa, nokuningi.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Ama-app eChrome awasebenzi ku-NickelOS. Cabangela enye i-app.
